🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 25, 2026

Sun, in its fall in Libra, holds an opposition to Neptune, in Aries. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Cancer, where it stands lowest. Sun faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire meets a bill. The same angle for three weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon in Pisces opens a gap you have to step into. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. From Libra, Sun agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. Mercury has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Pisces untitled. Sun squares you from Libra, and the cost objects. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. A week ago Moon was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, falls in Libra. Venus in Scorpio presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Since Sun crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. From Cancer, Mars offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. The opposition to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Air begins and is billed in the same gesture. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Venus occupies your sign: what you own is at hand, not in theory. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Libra, Sun hands you an opening. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Earth that starts things, billed for starting. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun trines you from Libra, and what you hold finds words unforced. Air that holds on, holding without strain. Unchanged for a week: you know what it asks.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Mars in Cancer sides with you before you have argued. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. It has held a week without changing its terms.
